original_test_intent: Establish that the active IFWI image on the intended GPU platform is uniquely identified and equals the project-approved firmware bundle version.
original_method: Query ifwi_active over the approved verified Redfish channel, retain only the required redacted component/version fields with audit metadata, and compare to the authoritative release mapping.
manual_activity: Firmware engineering/security approves the IFWI mapping and release target, resolves mismatches and decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Trusted BMC endpoint/TLS chain and network path
Expected active IFWI version and release-note authority
safety_requirements: Authenticate BMC and certificate before access
Use exact inventory member with least privilege
Require one unambiguous active IFWI response
Stop on trust/auth/schema/identity/version or audit anomaly
Do not expose secrets or invoke firmware actions
agent_execution_scope: Issue one authorized exact IFWI inventory read
Compare active version to the provided release entry
Do not disable trust, broaden to update endpoints or issue PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve endpoint/access and IFWI schema mapping
Resolve mismatch/security issues and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The broad insecure command cannot uniquely bind a returned version to active IFWI and mishandles credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: TLS-verify the project BMC and read exact ifwi_active using brokered read-only access, then compare the uniquely mapped active version.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IFWI active-image lookup, release-note check and source 5/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a minimal signed evidence row binding platform/BMC identity, ifwi_active URI, component ID, active flag/version and release bundle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Secures the request and prevents cross-component version selection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Only IFWI evidence satisfies this row; adjacent firmware members remain independent.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: IFWI version strings may include build metadata needing an approved normalization rule.

project_override_considerations: An equivalent secure vendor query may be used only if it identifies the same active IFWI component and approved release; flashing remains out of scope.
expected_evidence: Exact ifwi_active URI/status/time and redacted member

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and ifwi_active procedure consistently identify the active IFWI version; missing secure access/release inputs do not alter intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Trusted access, component map and expected value can be supplied; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Replaces an unsafe generic inventory lookup with a trusted, exact active-IFWI assertion traceable to the approved release.
independent_technical_reasoning: IFWI is a platform integration image, not interchangeable with controller or FPGA firmware. A matching numeric version from a broad list may belong to another component or inactive bank. The member identity, active state and release mapping must travel together, anchored to the verified BMC endpoint.
